status: Design only, unapplied and unexecuted; separate source claim and root execution grant required.
variants: same base plus two proposed test/docs patches
fixed observations: Exactly one old and one new existing-case observation, each with the same 1,100 ms post-constructor/pre-Ready controlled gate. No warmup or repeated observation.
gate entry: Immediately after Fixture constructor returns, before any Ready request/state or new-phase publication. The baseline constructor has published its single Speaking; the revised constructor has not.
owned gate: Private control-only overlay. An owned controller receives one entered marker, holds release until its monotonic 1,100 ms deadline from that marker, then writes exactly one release token. Its cancel channel/close wakes the gate on failure. Join/reap and direct group/session absence are required; an outer120s watchdog bounds the exact-case process. No product clock API or source change.
timing qualification: Actual held duration must be at least1,100 ms. Record late controller/gate releases, source/pre-step spans and raw outcomes; excessive post-release delays that also age Ready or the new Voice make the causal control inconclusive, never grounds to rerun.
old after release: Publish Ready request/state with their original500ms lifetimes and original at_us=1,000,000, then one unchanged fixture.step(unix_ms()). Original constructor Voice envelope has aged beyond500ms+50ms transport grace.
new after release: Create all test publishers before Ready; publish Ready request/state, then exactly one original Speaking payload last, and one unchanged fixture.step(unix_ms()).
diagnostics before original unwrap: Output.state missing/warnings/behaviours; output light/body presence; Service accepted/refused/input_errors counts; every input Subscriber topic/received/expired/repeated/wrong_type counters; gate enter/release and publication/step host timestamps. Retained Voice/Ready headers can be inspected after the step to bind stamp, wall timestamp, expiry and expired flag without adding another step or publication. No controller environment values.
expected discriminating result: Old missing light with VoiceTiming expiry counter and fresh Ready, new original light/Resting/asleep/body/ack assertions pass with no extra initial Voice sample. This tests the deliberate setup-age intervention only; no historical cause claim.
unqualified outcomes: Unexpected old pass, new failure, stale Ready, input/refusal error, cleanup failure or missing diagnostic boundary is retained and reviewed; no retry, deadline inflation or sampling until green.
invariants: One service step only, no poll until light and no retry.
Same Voice payload/typed logicalstamp at1,000,000/sequence1; no second sample.
Voice real envelope500ms and bus50ms grace unchanged.
No product code, runtime clock API or shared default-fixture behaviour change.
remaining risk: Any host stall during transport setup, between Ready and Voice publication, or after publication can still expire one input. This scoped setup-order correction does not guarantee arbitrary real-clock stalls.
